test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In an exam, a student scored 40% on the first paper out of a total of 200. How much percentage should the student score in the second paper out of 200 if he has to get 60% marks overall?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since both papers carry equal maximum marks (200 each), the overall percentage is simply the average of the individual percentages.

Overall % = (Paper 1 % + Paper 2 %) ÷ 2

60% = (40% + Paper 2 %) ÷ 2

120% = 40% + Paper 2 % ⇒ Paper 2 % = 80%

**∴ The correct answer is 80%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b59b5569fbb3ba6d3889bd191f15c2817276de43c6fe769a6d90e4f6d0af4e58.png] 

**Given:**

Maximum marks for Paper 1 = 200

Maximum marks for Paper 2 = 200

Overall target percentage required = 60%

**Calculation:**

⇒ Marks obtained in Paper 1 = (40 ÷ 100) × 200 = 80 marks

⇒ Total maximum marks for both papers = 200 + 200 = 400

⇒ Target marks required overall = (60 ÷ 100) × 400 = 240 marks

⇒ Marks required in Paper 2 = Target marks required − Marks in Paper 1

⇒ Marks required in Paper 2 = 240 − 80 = 160 marks

⇒ Percentage required in Paper 2 = (160 ÷ 200) × 100

⇒ Percentage required = 80%

**∴ The correct answer is 80%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Percentage (Equal Base)

When calculating overall percentages for components with equal total bases, the combined percentage is strictly the simple average: Combined % = (P₁ + P₂) ÷ 2.

Weighted Average (Unequal Base)

If the total marks are unequal (say W₁ and W₂), the weighted average method is required: Overall % = (W₁P₁ + W₂P₂) ÷ (W₁ + W₂).

Percentage to Absolute Value

To convert any percentage to absolute marks, use the standard formula: Value = (Percentage ÷ 100) × Total Base.
